entities.summary: Bruno Contrada was an Italian police and intelligence officer who was the police chief of Palermo and deputy director of the civil intelligence service SISDE. He was arrested based on revelations of former Sicilian Mafiosi turned pentiti ; Gaspare Mutolo and Giuseppe Marchese.
